definitions.explanation: A person skilled in swordsmanship. Can refer to historical swordsmen, modern kendo practitioners, or fictional sword-wielding characters.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{優|すぐ}れた{剣士|けんし}だ。
{若|わか}い{剣士|けんし}たちが{大会|たいかい}で{競|きそ}い{合|あ}った。
examples.english: Young fencers competed against each other in the tournament.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}に{名|な}を{残|のこ}した{伝説|でんせつ}の{剣士|けんし}について{本|ほん}を{読|よ}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm reading a book about legendary swordsmen who left their mark on history.

notes:
{剣士|けんし} refers to a person skilled in sword fighting. It is used across historical, modern martial arts, and fictional contexts.

FORMS:
{剣|けん} (sword) + {士|し} (person, practitioner)

USAGE:
- Historical: samurai and sword masters of feudal Japan
- Modern: {剣道|けんどう} (kendo) practitioners and fencers
- Fiction: a common character class in anime, manga, and games

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凄腕|すごうで}の{剣士|けんし}: a highly skilled swordsman
- {伝説|でんせつ}の{剣士|けんし}: a legendary swordsman
- {女|おんな}{剣士|けんし}: a female swordsman
- {最強|さいきょう}の{剣士|けんし}: the strongest swordsman

RELATED WORDS:
- {剣道|けんどう}: kendo (the way of the sword)
- {剣術|けんじゅつ}: swordsmanship, sword technique
- {剣|つるぎ} / {刀|かたな}: sword
- {武士|ぶし}: warrior, samurai
- {侍|さむらい}: samurai
